objective: Reduce B2 lockout after bounded state divergence without reopening compromised or replayed state.

mandatory.requirement: Use an established cryptographic core; T1 adds recovery control and state management only.
Bind every recovery message to spacecraft identity, recovery ID, target epoch, monotonic counter, and transcript.
Use two-phase activation or equivalent confirmation so candidate state cannot authorize normal commands.
Retain at most N skipped or candidate states for at most H contact windows; N and H are experiment parameters.
Never automatically reactivate a lower epoch or key marked compromised.
Require a fresh post-recovery command and authenticated telemetry exchange before SUCCESS.
Define deterministic behavior for loss of prepare, response, commit, confirmation, and status messages.
Every attempt terminates in exactly one defined outcome class.
Bound denial-of-service cost from repeated recovery triggers, cache exhaustion, and replay floods.
Produce independent ground, spacecraft, and evidence-service records.
State the passive-adversary interval required for any PCS claim.
Report security and availability separately, not as a hidden composite score.

prohibited_shortcuts: fallback to a prior compromised epoch
treating key generation as recovery completion
importing unrelated one-message stateless recovery designs
